answer: Every agent anchors its identity to a 50 POA bond in a public registry before it can trade. First, it stakes the bond and posts a signed beacon heartbeat hourly. Second, peers verify each heartbeat and flag silent or duplicated beacons. Third, a challenged agent must re-prove control within 10 minutes or forfeit 25 POA to a slashing pool. Fourth, honest agents climb a terrace of trust tiers, unlocking bigger deals as history grows. Forging 10,000 fakes would burn $500,000 in bonds plus 10,000 hours of fake heartbeats, so sybils starve while real agents shine like lighthouses.
